NDT software in Pasadena, Texas: shops, a refinery and Bayport chemicals

NDT software for Pasadena, Texas has to serve two worlds at once: fabrication and machine shops that need weld inspection every day, and plant work at the refinery and chemical sites along the Houston Ship Channel and in the Bayport Industrial District. The Atlantis ERP solution gives Pasadena inspection companies one system for technician certifications, instrument calibration, crew dispatch, NDT reports, quotes and invoices.

The Chevron Pasadena refinery sits on the Ship Channel and recently completed an upgrade that raised its capacity to handle lighter crude, with a phased start-up through early 2025. Along the channel and towards Bayport, chemical plants, terminals and industrial service yards line the roads. Inland, along streets such as Red Bluff and Spencer Highway, Pasadena has a large base of fabrication shops, pressure vessel builders, pipe spool shops and machine shops serving the whole Houston area. San Jacinto College's Central campus in Pasadena trains process technicians and craft workers, which feeds the local skilled labour pool.

The typical Pasadena NDT contractor is often shop-based, with a shielded radiography bay or a yard, a small team of Level IIs, and trainees working towards Level I and II. They split time between in-shop weld inspection for fabricators and field work at plants. OSHA process safety management governs plant mechanical integrity, TCEQ monitors emissions, and turnarounds peak in spring and fall, with hurricane season from June through November.

ERP for NDT companies in Pasadena: shop work and field work in one system

An ERP for NDT companies in Pasadena has to handle steady daily shop work and bursty field work without separate systems. Shop work is repetitive: the same fabricator sends spools every week, each needing RT or UT on butt welds and a report per spool or per batch. Field work is irregular: a turnaround or a Bayport plant repair arrives with little warning and needs a crew, instruments and paperwork fast.

The Atlantis ERP handles both. Fabrication customers can have standing projects with client PO, contract, methods, codes, scope and acceptance criteria. Project tasks carry method, technician, component, result, indication and defect counts, and procedure and WPS references, so each spool or weld batch is traceable. Field jobs use the same records with dispatch, site GPS coordinates and mobilisation dates.

Everything flows to billing: timesheets with work type, method, billable flag and rate multiplier, and invoices with labour, equipment and consumables subtotals. See all apps at Atlantis ERP apps.

NDT reporting software for Pasadena fabrication shops

NDT reporting software for Pasadena fabrication work must turn out weld reports quickly and match the fabricator's and the end client's requirements. The NDT Reports app covers RT, computed radiography, UT, PAUT, TOFD, MT, PT, VT, PMI, hardness, ferrite and PWHT among its 17 report types.

Weld and job lines carry defect type and orientation, and each report records WPS, drawing numbers, work order, contract, procedure and standard references. RT reports capture source, technique, IQI type and placement. PAUT reports hold focal laws. Ferrite reports matter for stainless and duplex fabrication, PMI for alloy verification, and hardness and PWHT reports for heat-treated welds on pressure vessels and piping.

Reports go through draft, in progress, review, approved and sent, with inspector, reviewer and approver signatures and a third-party or authorized inspector name and signature, which is common when an authorized inspector witnesses code work in the shop. Fabricators often forward your reports into their own data books, so versioned company templates in Excel, Word, PDF or HTML are set up with your logo and header. Excel templates fill automatically from field-to-cell mapping, which saves hours on repetitive spool reports.

Technician certification tracking for Pasadena trainees and Level IIs

Technician certification tracking software for Pasadena has to follow technicians as they progress, not just record final certs. Many Pasadena contractors hire trainees from the local labour pool and bring them up to Level I and II under their written practice. The Certificates app records level from trainee through I, II and III, with method, scheme (SNT-TC-1A, CP-189, ISO 9712, PCN, CSWIP or other), certifying body, dates, OJT hours, training hours and exam passed.

Examination sheets hold general, specific and practical scores against a passing score, with exam files attached. Certificate templates per scheme set validity in months, whether a vision test and exam are required, and minimum OJT and training hours. That gives your Level III a clear view of who is ready to sit an exam and who still needs hours.

Status is calculated as active, expiring soon, expired or revoked, with warning tasks 90 days before expiry and configurable email alerts. Vision tests are tracked with near vision, far vision, colour perception and contrast. Timesheets warn when a technician logs work without a valid certificate, which stops a trainee being billed as a Level II by accident.

eLearning for Pasadena NDT trainees

The eLearning app gives Pasadena companies a course portal for their own staff, with Level I, II and III sections, video lessons from OneDrive or SharePoint with download protection, quizzes that can be imported from Word files, and certificates of completion.

Admins create learner accounts and grant or revoke access. Learners see a dashboard of their courses and progress. This works well for companies that run classroom training in-house and want trainees to review material between shifts. Training hours can then be recorded on the technician's certification record.

Atlantis NDT also offers ASNT SNT-TC-1A-based NDT training, and the Practical NDT 3D simulator lets trainees practise technique on virtual parts before they touch a real weld. For a shop-based Pasadena company with a steady intake of trainees, the combination of eLearning, certification tracking and OJT hours in one system makes written practice compliance much easier to show.

Crew dispatch software for Pasadena field and plant work

Crew dispatch software for Pasadena needs to pull techs out of the shop for field work without leaving the shop short. The Team Assignments app runs jobs through planned, dispatched, in field, submitted and closed, with site GPS coordinates and mobilisation and demobilisation dates.

The availability calendar records assigned, leave, training, sick and unavailable days, and blocks overlaps. Technicians and equipment serials cannot be double-booked, and the system warns if an instrument going to site is out of calibration. Each technician shows utilisation, current assignment and next available date.

When the Chevron refinery or a Bayport chemical plant calls for a crew, the dispatcher can see who is on shop work that can be moved and who is already committed. Training days entered in the availability calendar stop trainees being pulled onto jobs during classroom sessions. The project record holds safety induction and work permit fields, so plant entry requirements are visible before the crew is named.

Calibration management software for shop and field instruments

Calibration management software for Pasadena covers shop equipment that rarely leaves the building and field kits that move constantly. The Asset Management app tracks each flaw detector, PAUT unit, ferrite meter, PMI analyser, hardness tester, densitometer, yoke and probe by serial number, with condition, firmware, accessories and lifecycle status.

Calibration records include provider, certificate number, standard, range, uncertainty, accredited lab flag, result and next due date. The certificate register stores lab accreditation numbers and PDFs with expiry alerts. Issue and return goes through supervisor and manager approval with condition recorded. The maintenance log covers preventive and corrective work, firmware updates and probe replacements.

For radiography, the Fleet app records which vehicles can carry radioactive sources, with transport licence number and expiry, and the employee profile holds radiation safety training and badge numbers, useful for companies licensed by Texas DSHS for industrial radiography. Consumables such as film, chemicals, penetrant and couplant are tracked with reorder levels and low-stock flags.

NDT quoting and invoicing software for Pasadena fabricators and plants

NDT quoting and invoicing software for Pasadena should handle both a standing fabricator account and a one-off plant job. The Quotations app records job type, site, project dates and applicable codes, flags services by method and category, supports a global discount and produces a branded PDF with online acceptance and signature, converting to a sales order.

The Invoicing app carries project, job or PO number, site and invoice type on the header, with labour, equipment and consumables subtotals. Lines include cost centre, method, equipment serial, technician, rate type and days or hours. For shop work, you can bill per weld batch or per day, depending on how your fabricator contract is structured, set up during implementation.

The financial dashboard shows revenue, cost of sales, gross margin, operating expenses, EBITDA and outstanding invoices over twelve months, so you can compare shop and field margins.

Affordable, customizable ERP for inspection companies in Pasadena: implementation

An affordable, customizable ERP for inspection companies in Pasadena should fit shop and field work from day one. Atlantis NDT is led by an ASNT NDT Level III, and implementation is planned to avoid disrupting your shop throughput.

  • Workflow review: shop and field jobs, fabricator accounts, report formats and written practice.
  • Data import: technicians including trainees, OJT and training hours, certs, vision tests, instruments and calibration certificates.
  • Templates: weld report layouts matched to your fabricators' data books, plus quote and invoice layouts.
  • Integrations: the open REST API connects to QuickBooks, NetSuite, SAP or any system that accepts API connections, scoped per implementation.
  • Training: office, shop and field staff.

Pricing is a quote on request. Book a Pasadena NDT ERP demo and bring a sample spool report.

If your Pasadena shop is retyping weld reports and tracking trainee hours on paper, a short demo will show the difference. Request a quote for your Pasadena inspection company. If plant clients want results on a 3D model, see Digital Twin Reporting.

What to ask in an NDT ERP demo if you work the Pasadena ship channel plants

Pasadena crews rarely work one site at a time. On a normal week a company may have a resident crew at one refinery, a turnaround surge a few miles down the Ship Channel, and a shop job back at the yard. A demo should prove the system handles that spread, not just a tidy single project. Bring your own messy week and ask the presenter to load it.

  • Show a technician whose UT Level II certificate expires during a scheduled turnaround, and show the warning before the crew list is locked.
  • Move two technicians from one plant to another mid-week and show how the timesheets and the invoice lines follow them.
  • Pull an instrument out of calibration and show that it can no longer be assigned to a job.
  • Produce a report pack for a plant owner in its own template, with the certificates of everyone who signed it attached.
  • Split one invoice across two plant cost centres the way Ship Channel owners often ask.

If the answers are shown live on your own data, you will know within an hour whether the ERP fits. Ask for a demo built around your own crews and plants.

Frequently asked questions

One that produces weld reports with WPS and drawing references, tracks technician certifications and calibration, and bills from timesheets. The Atlantis ERP does all of this in one system.

Can it track trainees working towards Level I and II?

Yes. Certifications record trainee through Level III, OJT hours, training hours and exam scores, with templates setting minimum hours per scheme.

Does it support ferrite and PMI reports?

Yes. Ferrite, PMI and hardness are among the 17 built-in report types.

Is it affordable for a small NDT company in Pasadena?

Yes. It is affordable, accessible and fully customizable, with pricing as a quote on request.

Can our trainees study online?

Yes. The eLearning app provides Level I, II and III course sections, protected videos, quizzes and completion certificates.

How do we see a demo?

Contact us and we will show it using your own report formats.
